title: Establish the forensic standalone baseline
purpose: Select and promote one exact standalone candidate as the reproducible forensic baseline from which controlled architectural seams may later be introduced.

baseline.candidateName: RC715 durable library and rename candidate
baseline.selectionRule: Promoted after exact reconstruction, mandatory automated checks, governance review, and accountable-owner human validation PASS.

invariants: No functional, UX, storage, identifier, or contract change is mixed with the promotion decision.
The promoted source commit is exactly the source that reconstructs the selected RC715 artifact.
The artifact is rebuilt from a clean checkout and matches the recorded SHA-256.
The tested artifact and the promoted artifact are identical.
Known limitations and unproven claims remain explicitly recorded.
Promotion of the standalone baseline does not authorize held platform work.
adversarialTests: source and nested package hashes were verified before extraction
archive traversal, absolute paths, duplicate paths, and symbolic links were rejected
the source was rebuilt in GitHub Actions and matched the expected artifact hash
mandatory non-browser checks passed from the imported source
repository governance validation passed after the import and provenance correction
nonGoals: add accounts, synchronization, catalog, commerce, or tenancy
independentReview: QA and provenance through GitHub Actions reconstruction

result.nextArchitectureGate: R3 behavioral protection before the first architectural seam

rollback: Revoke the promotion in governor-state.json and revert the promotion-governance pull request. The immutable source commit and artifact hashes remain available for forensic comparison; no application data migration or remote-system change is part of this promotion.
